source: Existing VIIRS R2 publication; retired-server safe daily reports

check_level.all_publications: Completion paths/sizes/valid digest declarations versus LIST; date and lineage checks
check_level.all_quality: Small JSON GET (If-Match), actual SHA-256 versus manifest and GET metadata, per-scene sums and QA/unit/time checks
check_level.silver_gold: LIST size versus manifest; row counts from archived per-day reports; SHA metadata/lineage HEAD sampled on earliest/middle/latest published days
check_level.bronze: Referenced filenames exist in LIST; source hashes and units from processing quality records, not rehashed raw files
check_level.latest_day_footer_sample: Range-only Parquet metadata for actual schema/row counts/statistics; no full Parquet download
check_level.not_performed: Full NetCDF/Parquet downloads, Parquet unique-pixel/content revalidation, new CMR queries, cloud/land coverage validation, processing, collection, or remote writes

limitations: CONSISTENT_METADATA_AND_QUALITY does not mean full-byte Silver/Gold validation or scientific QA approval.
NO_PAIRED_CMR is conditional on the original product-pair/search policy; missing days are not zero-valued observations.
CMR search BBOX is not an observed swath/pixel footprint. Native geolocated pixel centers were assigned to annual SGIS administrative polygons; no resampling.
Finite brightness temperature with source QA=0 is the current Gold inclusion rule; it does not certify cloud-free measurements or physical range validity.
Gold rows are dong x swath groups. Pixel totals include repeated observations and are not unique ground area.
Granule UTC and KST times are source coverage metadata; scan timestamps are TAI93 scan starts, not exact pixel exposure times.
No rainfall ground truth, heavy-rain labels, or Sentinel/NGII integration is inferred.
